papers.title: Restorative resection in robot-assisted versus laparoscopic total mesorectal excision: systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.authors: Genders C, Wentink J, Geitenbeek R, Hompes R, van Praagh J, Consten E
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: The surgical treatment of rectal cancer is based on the principle of total mesorectal excision (TME). Owing to its technological advantages, robot-assisted total mesorectal excision (R-TME) is hypothesized to facilitate primary anastomosis more frequently than laparoscopic total mesorectal excision (L-TME). This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to investigate whether R-TME is associated with a higher likelihood of restorative surgery compared with L-TME.
METHODS: This systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted in accordance with PRISMA guidelines. The protocol was prospectively registered in PROSPERO, the international prospective register of systematic reviews (registration number: 1106767). PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, the Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were searched for studies from January 2010 to January 2026. Pooled ORs and mean differences were calculated using a random-effects model.
RESULTS: Twenty studies were included, reporting on 7133 patients. The pooled analysis demonstrated a significantly higher likelihood of restorative surgery with R-TME compared with L-TME (OR 1.43 (95% c.i. 1.04 to 1.98)). In a subgroup analysis of studies including patients after 2020, a stronger effect was observed (OR 2.86 (95% c.i. 1.80 to 4.53)). No significant differences were observed in anastomotic leakage, postoperative complications, reoperations, and readmissions. R-TME was associated with a lower conversion rate compared with L-TME (OR 0.37 (95% c.i. 0.28 to 0.49)).
CONCLUSION: R-TME is associated with a higher likelihood of primary anastomosis formation while maintaining a comparable safety profile. The more pronounced effect in recent studies likely reflects increasing surgical expertise. Future research should determine whether these advantages translate into measurable improvements in patient quality of life.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：直腸癌的手術治療基於全直腸系膜切除術（TME）原則。由於技術優勢，機器人輔助TME（R-TME）被認為可能比腹腔鏡TME（L-TME）更常促成一次性吻合（restorative surgery）。本系統性回顧與統合分析旨在探討R-TME是否與較高的保留腸道手術機率相關，相較於L-TME。

方法：本系統性回顧與統合分析依循PRISMA指引進行。研究計畫已於PROSPERO國際前瞻性系統性回顧註冊系統登錄（註冊號：1106767）。檢索PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Web of Science及Cochrane Library，納入2010年1月至2026年1月之研究。使用隨機效應模型計算合併OR值與平均差。

結果：共納入20篇研究，報告7133名病人。合併分析顯示R-TME相較於L-TME，保留腸道手術的機率顯著較高（OR 1.43，95%信賴區間1.04至1.98）。在2020年後病人的次群組分析中，觀察到更強的效果（OR 2.86，95%信賴區間1.80至4.53）。吻合口漏、術後併發症、再手術及再入院率均無顯著差異。R-TME相較於L-TME有較低的轉開腹率（OR 0.37，95%信賴區間0.28至0.49）。

結論：R-TME與較高的一次性吻合形成機率相關，同時維持相當的安全性。近期研究中更顯著的效果可能反映手術技術日益精熟。未來研究應確定這些優勢是否能轉化為病人生活品質上可測量的改善。

papers.action: 目前不需改變常規術式選擇；可作為與病人討論機器人手術潛在保肛優勢的輔助資訊，但須留意選擇性偏差。

papers.title: Role of circulating tumour DNA in predicting complete clinical response and local regrowth after total neoadjuvant therapy for rectal cancer: meta-analysis
papers.authors: Lal N, Shukla S, Hodges N, Brown G, Jenkins J
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Non-operative management after total neoadjuvant therapy (TNT) has emerged as a potential strategy for patients with locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC) achieving clinical complete response (cCR). Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) has been proposed as a systemic biomarker to augment response assessment, but its role in predicting cCR and local regrowth remains uncertain.
METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis were performed of studies evaluating ctDNA dynamics in patients with LARC undergoing TNT. PubMed, EMBASE, and Web of Science databases were searched from database inception to 31 March 2026. Primary outcomes were the association between post-TNT ctDNA status and cCR and sustained cCR. Pooled odds ratios (ORs) were calculated using a random-effects model.
RESULTS: Six studies comprising 597 patients were included. ctDNA negativity following TNT was associated with higher likelihood of cCR (OR 8.01; 95% confidence interval (c.i.) 1.43 to 44.90; I2 = 27.0%). The association with sustained cCR was not statistically significant (OR 3.46; 95% c.i. 0.03 to 394.64; I2 = 59.9%). Across studies, post-TNT ctDNA positivity was associated with inferior disease-free, distant recurrence-free, and progression-free survival. ctDNA demonstrated high specificity and positive predictive value for residual disease, but low sensitivity for the detection of residual local disease and local regrowth, with a substantial proportion of patients with residual tumour remaining ctDNA negative at restaging.
CONCLUSION: Post-TNT ctDNA positivity may identify patients at increased risk of adverse oncological outcomes. However, ctDNA negativity was not consistently associated with the absence of residual local disease, limiting its utility as an independent determinant of organ preservation eligibility. ctDNA should be interpreted as a complementary tool for systemic risk stratification alongside established anatomical assessment.

papers.title_zh: 循環腫瘤DNA在預測直腸癌全直腸新輔助治療（TNT）後臨床完全緩解（cCR）與局部再生長中的角色：統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：全直腸新輔助治療（TNT）後之非手術處置已成為局部進行性直腸癌（LARC）達到臨床完全緩解（cCR）病人之潛在策略。循環腫瘤DNA（ctDNA）已被提議作為增強反應評估之全身性生物標記，但其在預測cCR與局部再生長中的角色仍不確定。

方法：對評估LARC病人接受TNT後ctDNA動態變化之研究進行系統性回顧與統合分析。檢索PubMed、EMBASE與Web of Science資料庫，自資料庫建立起至2026年3月31日。主要結果為TNT後ctDNA狀態與cCR及持續cCR之關聯。採用隨機效應模型計算彙總勝算比（OR）。

結果：共納入6篇研究、597名病人。TNT後ctDNA陰性與較高cCR可能性相關（OR 8.01；95%信賴區間1.43至44.90；I2 = 27.0%）。與持續cCR之關聯未達統計顯著（OR 3.46；95%信賴區間0.03至394.64；I2 = 59.9%）。跨研究而言，TNT後ctDNA陽性與較差的無病存活、無遠端復發存活及無惡化存活相關。ctDNA對殘餘疾病展現高特異性與陽性預測值，但對偵測局部殘餘疾病與局部再生長之敏感性低，相當大比例有殘餘腫瘤之病人於再分期時仍為ctDNA陰性。

結論：TNT後ctDNA陽性可能有助於辨識較高不良腫瘤學結果風險之病人。然而，ctDNA陰性並未一致與局部殘餘疾病之缺乏相關，限制其作為器官保留資格之獨立判斷工具之實用性。ctDNA應被解讀為與既有解剖學評估並行之全身性風險分層輔助工具。
papers.score_reason: 方法嚴謹但僅納入6篇研究，持續cCR之信賴區間極寬幾乎無統計意義，結論本身也謹慎指出ctDNA不可單獨用於W&W篩選，對臨床決策有警示意義但證據仍嫌薄弱。
papers.relevance_why: 直接涉及目前大腸直腸外科熱門議題——直腸癌觀察等待（W&W）策略中ctDNA是否可輔助篩選病人。

papers.action: 不可單獨以ctDNA陰性判定W&W資格；仍須併用MRI、內視鏡等解剖學評估，ctDNA僅作全身性風險分層輔助。

papers.title: A systematic review and meta-analysis of preoperative MRI-based pelvimetry in predicting surgical difficulty in rectal cancer: Implications for personalised surgical planning
papers.journal_full: Colorectal disease : the official journal of the Association of Coloproctology of Great Britain and Ireland
papers.authors: Kitaguchi D, Kolbinger F, Dipanjyoti P, Jadhav K, Oda T, Forgione A
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-based pelvimetry has been investigated for predicting surgical difficulty in total mesorectal excision (TME) for rectal cancer. However, heterogeneity in pelvimetric parameters, surrogate outcomes, and study design has resulted in inconsistent evidence. This systematic review aimed to synthesise the evidence on commonly used MRI parameters and difficulty surrogates and assess their methodological robustness and clinical relevance.
METHODS: PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Library were systematically searched through December 2025 for studies evaluating preoperative MRI pelvimetry in patients undergoing TME for rectal cancer. Outcome parameters were surrogate measures of surgical difficulty, including operating time, intraoperative blood loss, conversion to open surgery, pathological quality metrics, and postoperative complications. Risk of bias was assessed using the Risk of Bias in Non-randomised Studies of Exposures (ROBINS-E) tool. This systematic review and meta-analysis was reported in accordance with the PRISMA 2020 statement and prospectively registered (PROSPERO: CRD420261287153).
RESULTS: Thirty-six studies comprising 8,364 patients were included. Common parameters included sagittal measurements and axial interspinous distance (ISD) and intertuberous distance (ITD). Definitions of surgical difficulty varied substantially. ROBINS-E identified some concerns in 30 studies, a high risk of bias in five, and insufficient information in one. Meta-analysis of six studies (n = 769) showed that shorter ISD (mean difference [MD] -5.13 mm, 95% CI -6.61 to -3.65; p < 0.001; I2 = 0%) and ITD (MD -7.32 mm, 95% CI -10.24 to -4.39; p = 0.004; I2 = 0%) were significantly associated with surrogate measures of surgical difficulty.
CONCLUSIONS: MRI-based pelvimetry, particularly ISD and ITD, may help predict surgical difficulty in TME. However, methodological heterogeneity limits broader quantitative synthesis and highlights the need for standardised pelvimetric protocols.

papers.title_zh: 術前MRI骨盆測量法預測直腸癌手術困難度之系統性回顧與統合分析：對個人化手術規劃的意義
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：以磁振造影（MRI）為基礎的骨盆測量法已被用於預測直腸癌全直腸系膜切除術（TME）的手術困難度。然而，骨盆測量參數、替代指標及研究設計的異質性導致證據結果不一致。本系統性回顧旨在整合常用MRI參數與困難度替代指標的證據，並評估其方法學穩健性與臨床相關性。方法：系統性檢索PubMed、Embase及Cochrane Library至2025年12月，納入評估直腸癌TME手術前MRI骨盆測量之研究。結果參數為手術困難度之替代指標，包括手術時間、術中失血量、轉開腹手術、病理品質指標及術後併發症。使用ROBINS-E工具評估偏誤風險。本系統性回顧與統合分析依PRISMA 2020聲明撰寫，並於PROSPERO前瞻性註冊（CRD420261287153）。結果：共納入36篇研究，8,364名患者。常用參數包括矢狀面測量及軸向坐骨棘間距（ISD）與坐骨結節間距（ITD）。手術困難度的定義差異甚大。ROBINS-E評估顯示30篇研究有一定程度的擔憂，5篇具高偏誤風險，1篇資訊不足。對6篇研究（n=769）進行統合分析顯示，較短的ISD（平均差異[MD] -5.13 mm，95% CI -6.61至-3.65；p<0.001；I2=0%）及ITD（MD -7.32 mm，95% CI -10.24至-4.39；p=0.004；I2=0%）與手術困難度替代指標顯著相關。結論：以MRI為基礎的骨盆測量，特別是ISD及ITD，可能有助於預測TME手術困難度。然而，方法學異質性限制了更廣泛的量化整合，凸顯需要標準化骨盆測量方案之必要性。
papers.score_reason: PROSPERO註冊、樣本量大（8364人），但僅6/36篇可量化統合，且結果為替代指標之MD值，缺乏可直接應用的臨床切點。

papers.title: Follow-up colonoscopy after abnormal stool-based colorectal cancer screening: a systematic review of completion, timeliness and implementation strategies
papers.authors: Naserrudin N, Chong Woei Quan D, Adnan S, Krebanathan H, Edi Razman E, Abdullah M
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: To synthesise evidence on diagnostic colonoscopy completion and time-to-colonoscopy after abnormal stool-based colorectal cancer screening tests and to examine the implementation strategies and health-system configurations used to support follow-up.
DESIGN: Systematic review with narrative synthesis, reported in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses 2020 statement and the Synthesis Without Meta-analysis reporting guideline.
DATA SOURCES: We searched MEDLINE via PubMed, Embase via Ovid and Scopus for articles published from 1 January 2010 to 28 October 2025. Reference lists of included studies were also screened.
ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: Randomised and non-randomised trials, observational studies, mixed-methods studies and eligible programme evaluations involving adults with an abnormal faecal immunochemical test, guaiac faecal occult blood test or multitarget stool DNA-faecal immunochemical test were included. Eligible studies reported diagnostic colonoscopy completion, time to colonoscopy or implementation-related outcomes.
DATA EXTRACTION AND SYNTHESIS: Study characteristics, implementation strategies, colonoscopy completion, time-to-colonoscopy and sociodemographic differences were extracted using a piloted form. Risk of bias was assessed using the Revised Cochrane risk-of-bias tool for randomised trials, the Risk of Bias in Non-randomised Studies of Interventions or the Joanna Briggs Institute tools, according to study design. Certainty of evidence was assessed using Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE). Because of differences in settings, study designs and outcome definitions, findings were synthesised narratively. Reported follow-up intervals were grouped into approximately ≤3, ≤6 and ≤12 months.
RESULTS: Twenty-five studies were included, predominantly from high-income settings. Colonoscopy completion within 6-12 months commonly ranged from approximately 30% to 55% in federally qualified health centres and safety-net settings to 70%-80% or higher in organised and integrated programmes. Time to colonoscopy ranged from approximately 42 to 184 days. Higher completion and shorter delays were more commonly reported in programmes combining real-time tracking, clearly assigned responsibility, proactive outreach or navigation and coordinated colonoscopy scheduling. Of the 25 studies, 1 was judged to have low overall risk of bias, 19 moderate risk and 5 serious risk. Certainty of evidence was low for colonoscopy completion at approximately 6 and 12 months and very low for approximately 3-month completion and time to colonoscopy.
CONCLUSIONS: Higher-performing post-abnormal-test pathways commonly incorporated registry-based tracking, clear ownership of abnormal results, proactive outreach or navigation and coordinated access to colonoscopy. However, confidence in the comparative performance of specific implementation bundles is limited by heterogeneous and predominantly observational evidence. Health systems serving under-resourced populations may require targeted investment in tracking, navigation and integrated scheduling to improve timely and equitable follow-up.
PROSPERO REGISTRATION NUMBER: PROSPERO CRD42024579672.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的：整合異常糞便篩檢（大腸直腸癌）後診斷性大腸鏡完成率及其檢查時間之證據，並檢視支持後續追蹤之執行策略與健康照護系統配置。設計：依循PRISMA 2020聲明與Synthesis Without Meta-analysis報告指引，進行敘事性整合的系統性文獻回顧。資料來源：檢索MEDLINE（透過PubMed）、Embase（透過Ovid）及Scopus，納入2010年1月1日至2025年10月28日發表之文章，並篩選納入研究之參考文獻清單。納入條件：納入隨機及非隨機試驗、觀察性研究、混合方法研究及符合條件之計畫評估，對象為糞便免疫化學檢測、化學法糞便潛血檢測或多標靶糞便DNA-免疫化學檢測異常之成人。符合條件之研究須報告診斷性大腸鏡完成率、至大腸鏡之時間或執行相關結果。資料擷取與整合：使用預先試行之表格擷取研究特徵、執行策略、大腸鏡完成率、至大腸鏡之時間及社經人口差異。偏誤風險依研究設計使用Revised Cochrane risk-of-bias工具（隨機試驗）、Risk of Bias in Non-randomised Studies of Interventions工具或Joanna Briggs Institute工具評估。證據確定性使用GRADE評估。因場域、研究設計及結果定義之差異，採敘事性整合。回報之追蹤區間分為約≤3個月、≤6個月及≤12個月分組。結果：共納入25篇研究，多來自高收入國家場域。6-12個月內大腸鏡完成率在聯邦合格健康中心及安全網場域約為30%至55%，在組織化及整合式計畫中則為70%-80%或更高。至大腸鏡之時間約為42至184天。結合即時追蹤系統、明確分配責任、主動外展或導航以及協調大腸鏡排程之計畫，較常報告有較高之完成率及較短之延遲。25篇研究中，1篇整體偏誤風險低，19篇為中度風險，5篇為嚴重風險。約6個月及12個月大腸鏡完成率之證據確定性為低，約3個月完成率及至大腸鏡時間之證據確定性為極低。結論：表現較佳之異常檢測後照護路徑通常納入登錄式追蹤系統、明確之異常結果責任歸屬、主動外展或導航，以及協調式大腸鏡取得。然而，異質且多為觀察性之證據限制了對特定執行組合之比較效果之信心。服務資源不足族群之健康照護系統可能需針對追蹤、導航及整合排程進行目標性投資，以改善及時且公平之後續追蹤。PROSPERO註冊號：CRD42024579672。

papers.title: Talc Use and Risk of Cancer: An Umbrella Review and Overlapped Analysis
papers.authors: Mayta-Tovalino F, Cabanillas-Lazo M, Quispe-Vicuña C, Espinoza-Carhuancho F, Hernandez A
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: This umbrella review aimed to systematically synthesize and critically appraise the available evidence from systematic reviews and meta-analyses evaluating the association between talc exposure and cancer risk in humans.
METHODS: This umbrella review was conducted in accordance with the PRIOR guidelines and registered in PROSPERO. A comprehensive search of PubMed, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, and Epistemonikos was performed up to October 2024 without language or date restrictions. Eligible studies were systematic reviews evaluating any type of talc exposure in humans. Study selection and data extraction were performed independently, and risk of bias was assessed using the AMSTAR-2 tool.
RESULTS: Nine systematic reviews were included, eight combining cohort and case-control studies and one restricted to cohort studies. Cosmetic talc exposure was the most frequently investigated, with most reviews focused on ovarian cancer. Moderate overlap of study populations (9.2%) was identified, primarily related to Boon et al. Based on AMSTAR-2, confidence in the evidence was moderate in one review and critically low in seven, with frequent methodological shortcomings such as lack of protocol registration and unclear study exclusions. For occupational exposure, elevated risks were observed for overall cancer (RR 1.21; 95% CI 1.03-1.42) and colorectal cancer (SIR 1.59; 95% CI 1.07-2.26), while no increased risk was found for other cancer types. Four of five systematic reviews evaluating cosmetic talc exposure and ovarian cancer reported a statistically significant association with increased ovarian cancer risk, whereas one review found no statistically significant association. However, confidence in the results of the reviews included was predominantly low or critically low, reflecting important methodological limitations, including concerns regarding risk-of-bias assessment and reporting. Overall, the evidence supporting an association between cosmetic talc exposure and ovarian cancer was of limited confidence.
CONCLUSION: There is limited evidence from systematic reviews regarding the association of exposure to cosmetic talc with an increased risk of developing ovarian cancer. Therefore, the results of the systematic reviews should be regarded as suggestive, rather than definitive, and further studies are required to demonstrate a causal relationship.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：本雨傘綜述旨在系統性綜合並批判性評估現有系統性回顧與統合分析中，評估人體滑石暴露與癌症風險關聯之證據。方法：本雨傘綜述依循PRIOR指引進行，並於PROSPERO註冊。於2024年10月前對PubMed、Embase、Scopus、Web of Science及Epistemonikos進行全面檢索，無語言或年代限制。納入標準為評估任何類型人體滑石暴露之系統性回顧。研究篩選與資料擷取獨立進行，並使用AMSTAR-2工具評估偏誤風險。結果：共納入9篇系統性回顧，其中8篇結合世代研究與病例對照研究，1篇僅限世代研究。化妝品滑石暴露為最常被探討的暴露類型，多數回顧聚焦於卵巢癌。研究族群存在中度重疊（9.2%），主要與Boon等人的研究相關。依AMSTAR-2評估，1篇回顧的證據信心為中等，7篇為極低，常見方法學缺陷包括缺乏計畫書註冊及研究排除標準不明確。對於職業暴露，觀察到整體癌症風險上升（RR 1.21；95% CI 1.03-1.42）及大腸直腸癌風險上升（SIR 1.59；95% CI 1.07-2.26），而其他癌症類型未發現風險增加。在評估化妝品滑石暴露與卵巢癌之5篇系統性回顧中，4篇報告統計上顯著的風險上升關聯，1篇則未發現統計顯著關聯。然而，納入回顧之結果信心多為低或極低，反映出重要的方法學限制，包括偏誤風險評估與報告方面的疑慮。整體而言，支持化妝品滑石暴露與卵巢癌關聯之證據信心有限。結論：系統性回顧證據顯示化妝品滑石暴露與卵巢癌風險上升之關聯證據有限。因此，這些系統性回顧之結果應視為提示性而非決定性，需要進一步研究以證實因果關係。

papers.title: Epidemiology of inflammatory bowel disease in the Middle East and North Africa: a multinational, tertiary care registry (MIRAGE) study
papers.authors: Shehab M, Azzam N, Al-Hindawi A, Alrashed F, Al-Bawardy B, Abid S
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is increasing in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), yet region-specific evidence on phenotype and treatment patterns remains limited. We aimed to characterize IBD epidemiology, clinical phenotypes, and therapy use across MENA centers.
METHODS: This was a multicenter cross-sectional study across 13 centers in seven MENA countries. Adults with ulcerative colitis (UC), Crohn's disease (CD), or IBD-unclassified (IBD-U) were included. Demographics, Montreal phenotype/behavior, smoking status, disease duration, perianal disease, and therapies were collected. Descriptive statistics and between-group comparisons were performed.
RESULTS: We analyzed 10 340 patients (52% UC, 45% CD, 3% IBD-U). Mean age was 39.79 ± 14.4 years in UC and 34.57 ± 12.9 years in CD (P < .0001). UC patients were slightly more often female (51.6%), while CD patients were male-predominant (59.0%). Current smoking was more common in CD than in UC (12.0% vs 5.6%). Mean disease duration was 9.73 ± 7.5 years, longest in Jordan (14.1 years) and shortest in Qatar (2.45 years; P < .001). Biologic exposure differed by subtype (P < .001), with the highest rate in CD (57.9%). In UC, extensive colitis (E3) was the most common phenotype. In CD, ileocolonic involvement (L3) predominated with mainly non-stricturing, non-penetrating behavior (B1). Perianal disease affected approximately 13% overall, with rates varying by country, highest in UAE and lowest in Egypt and Qatar.
CONCLUSION: This multi-country hospital-based registry study helps define contemporary IBD patterns in MENA: slight UC predominance, high rates of extensive UC and ileocolonic B1 CD, and heterogeneous biologic use. Our data provide insights into regional IBD epidemiological trends and treatment adoption.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景與目的：發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）在中東與北非（MENA）地區發生率正在上升，然而該地區特有的表型與治療模式證據仍有限。本研究旨在描述MENA地區各中心IBD之流行病學、臨床表型與治療使用狀況。方法：這是一項橫跨7個MENA國家、13個中心的多中心橫斷面研究。納入診斷為潰瘍性結腸炎（UC）、克隆氏症（CD）或未分類IBD（IBD-U）的成人患者。收集人口學資料、Montreal表型/行為分類、吸菸狀態、病程、肛周疾病及治療方式。進行描述性統計與組間比較。結果：共分析10,340名患者（52% UC、45% CD、3% IBD-U）。UC患者平均年齡為39.79 ± 14.4歲，CD患者為34.57 ± 12.9歲（P < .0001）。UC患者女性稍多（51.6%），CD患者則男性為主（59.0%）。CD目前吸菸比例高於UC（12.0% vs 5.6%）。平均病程為9.73 ± 7.5年，約旦最長（14.1年），卡達最短（2.45年；P < .001）。生物製劑使用率依疾病亞型而異（P < .001），CD最高（57.9%）。UC中以廣泛性結腸炎（E3）最常見；CD則以迴腸結腸型（L3）為主，大多為非狹窄非穿透型（B1）。肛周疾病整體約影響13%患者，各國比例不同，阿拉伯聯合大公國最高，埃及與卡達最低。結論：此多國醫院基礎登錄研究有助於界定當代MENA地區IBD型態：UC略為多數、廣泛性UC與迴腸結腸型B1 CD比例高、生物製劑使用具異質性。本資料提供該地區IBD流行病學趨勢與治療採用情形之見解。

papers.title: Cancer statistics for Hispanic/Latino people, 2026
papers.journal_full: CA: a cancer journal for clinicians
papers.authors: Saka A, Kratzer T, Giaquinto A, Mazzitelli N, Pinheiro P, Ortiz A
papers.abstract: The Hispanic/Latino population is the second largest racial and ethnic group in the United States, accounting for 20% of the total population (68 million), plus approximately 3 million Hispanic Americans residing in Puerto Rico. Herein, the American Cancer Society reports cancer occurrence, risk factors, and screening for US Hispanic people using federally funded, high-quality, population-based cancer registry data and national vital statistics and survey data. In 2026, an estimated 229,900 Hispanic people will be diagnosed with cancer, and 54,200 will die from the disease in the continental United States and Hawaii. Cancer incidence during 1998-2022 rose in Hispanic women (from 345 to 385 per 100,000) and fell in Hispanic men (from 471 to 389 per 100,000), narrowing the male-to-female incidence rate ratio from a peak of 1.40 (95% CI, 1.38-1.42) in 2002 to 1.01 (95% CI, 1.00-1.02; p = .02) in 2022. This pattern is partly driven by declining incidence of lung and prostate cancers among men and increasing incidence of breast and uterine corpus cancers among women. Although temporal trends mirror the general population, the Hispanic cancer distribution is distinct, consistent with relatively lower prevalence of smoking, alcohol drinking, and screening and higher prevalence of obesity and cancer-causing infections. Compared with White people, Hispanic people have one half the incidence of lung and urinary bladder cancers and 24% lower breast cancer but double the rate of liver, stomach, and gallbladder cancers, 61%-65% higher acute lymphocytic leukemia, and 36% higher cervical cancer. The cancer burden in Puerto Rico is distinct, with lower rates of lung cancer but higher rates of cervical, prostate, and colorectal cancers compared with other US Hispanic populations. Residents in Puerto Rico also experience lasting health care system challenges from extreme weather events. Thus, prevention efforts should target the unique cancer profile of the Hispanic population, including infection prevention and control, healthy eating, physical activity, and routine screening, especially for cervical and colorectal cancer that are 11 percentage points lower than White people.

papers.title_zh: 2026年西語裔/拉丁裔人口癌症統計
papers.abstract_zh: 西語裔/拉丁裔人口是美國第二大種族與族群，佔總人口20%（6800萬人），另有約300萬西語裔美國人居住於波多黎各。本文為美國癌症學會利用聯邦資助之高品質人口基礎癌症登記資料、全國生命統計與調查資料，報告美國西語裔人口之癌症發生率、危險因子與篩檢現況。2026年，預估美國本土與夏威夷將有229,900名西語裔人口被診斷癌症，54,200人將因癌症死亡。1998-2022年間，癌症發生率在西語裔女性上升（每10萬人345升至385），在西語裔男性下降（每10萬人471降至389），使男女發生率比值從2002年的峰值1.40（95% CI, 1.38-1.42）縮小至2022年的1.01（95% CI, 1.00-1.02；p=.02）。此模式部分源於男性肺癌與前列腺癌發生率下降，及女性乳癌與子宮體癌發生率上升。雖然時間趨勢與一般人口相似，但西語裔的癌症分布有其獨特性，與相對較低的吸菸、飲酒、篩檢比例及較高的肥胖與致癌感染比例一致。與白人相比，西語裔人口肺癌與膀胱癌發生率為一半，乳癌低24%，但肝癌、胃癌、膽囊癌發生率為兩倍，急性淋巴性白血病高61%-65%，子宮頸癌高36%。波多黎各的癌症負擔有其特殊性，肺癌發生率較低，但子宮頸癌、前列腺癌與大腸直腸癌發生率高於其他美國西語裔人口。波多黎各居民也持續承受極端天氣事件對醫療體系造成的衝擊。因此，預防措施應針對西語裔人口獨特的癌症特徵，包括感染防治、健康飲食、身體活動及常規篩檢，尤其是子宮頸癌與大腸直腸癌篩檢率較白人低11個百分點。

papers.title: Opportunistic Gastric Cancer Endoscopic Screening Integrated Into Population-Based Colorectal Cancer Screening: A Retrospective Economic Cost-Comparison Study
papers.authors: Mourato B, Pinto P, Vieira J, Vidinha M, Carvalho V, Pratas N
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Gastric cancer (GC) remains a major cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, with prognosis and treatment costs strongly influenced by disease stage at diagnosis. Endoscopic GC screening has been proposed for intermediate-to-high-risk countries, although its economic feasibility remains uncertain. This study evaluated the costs associated with opportunistic GC screening integrated into a colorectal cancer screening programme and compared modeled early-stage management scenarios with the real-world costs of managing Stages II-IV disease.
METHODS: A retrospective cost-comparison study was conducted from the perspective of the Portuguese National Health Service. Screening costs were derived from 377 fecal immunochemical testing-positive individuals undergoing one-time opportunistic esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD) during colonoscopy within the organized colorectal cancer screening programme, and treatment costs from a retrospective cohort of 222 patients with gastric adenocarcinoma. Direct medical costs were analyzed according to disease stage and compared with two modeled early-stage management scenarios.
RESULTS: Gastric precancerous conditions were identified in 46.9% of screened individuals, and gastric adenocarcinoma was detected in 0.8% (3/377). The estimated screening cost was €17,249 per cancer detected. Mean treatment and follow-up costs per patient were €32,140 for Stage II disease, €33,073 for Stage III disease, and €19,287 for Stage IV disease. The estimated cumulative cost of screening followed by ESD was €27,624, whereas screening followed by surgical treatment of Stage I disease was estimated at €44,493.
CONCLUSIONS: GC management is associated with substantial healthcare expenditure. The potential economic value of opportunistic GC screening is likely to depend on the detection of lesions amenable to endoscopic treatment.
TRAIL REGISTRATION: NCT07522320.

papers.title_zh: 將機會性胃癌內視鏡篩檢整合入大腸直腸癌篩檢計畫：一項回溯性經濟成本比較研究
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：胃癌（GC）仍是全球癌症死亡的主要原因之一，其預後與治療成本深受診斷時期別影響。內視鏡胃癌篩檢已被提議用於中高風險國家，但其經濟可行性仍不確定。本研究評估將機會性胃癌篩檢整合入大腸直腸癌篩檢計畫的相關成本，並比較模擬的早期處置情境與真實世界第II-IV期疾病管理成本。

方法：本研究以葡萄牙國家醫療服務（NHS）觀點進行回溯性成本比較研究。篩檢成本來自377名糞便免疫化學檢測（FIT）陽性者，於有組織的大腸直腸癌篩檢計畫中接受大腸鏡檢查時，同時進行一次性機會性食道胃十二指腸鏡檢查（EGD）；治療成本則來自222名胃腺癌病人的回溯性世代。直接醫療成本依疾病期別分析，並與兩種模擬的早期處置情境比較。

結果：46.9%受篩檢者發現胃癌前驅病變，0.8%（3/377）偵測到胃腺癌。估計每偵測1例癌症之篩檢成本為€17,249。每位病人之平均治療與追蹤成本：第II期為€32,140，第III期為€33,073，第IV期為€19,287。篩檢後接續內視鏡黏膜下剝離術（ESD）的累計估計成本為€27,624，而篩檢後接續第I期疾病手術治療之估計成本為€44,493。

結論：胃癌管理涉及相當大的醫療支出。機會性胃癌篩檢的潛在經濟價值，可能取決於是否能偵測到適合內視鏡治療的病灶。

試驗註冊：NCT07522320。

papers.title: Clinical and pathological characteristics of mucinous adenocarcinoma in colon cancer: comparison with classic adenocarcinoma
papers.authors: Acar B, Muhtaroğlu A, Kesi̇ci̇oğlu T, Acar S, Yilmaz E, Çeki̇ç Y
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Mucinous adenocarcinoma of the colon is defined by extracellular mucin occupying at least 50% of the tumour. Although it is often regarded as a distinct histological subtype, its clinicopathological profile remains variable across published series. We compared mucinous and classic adenocarcinoma in a colon-only surgical cohort.
METHODS: We retrospectively reviewed patients who underwent oncological resection for colon adenocarcinoma between October 2021 and March 2026. Rectal tumours, neoadjuvant-treated cases and signet ring cell carcinoma were excluded. Clinicopathological variables were compared using Mann-Whitney U, Pearson chi-square or Fisher exact tests. Multivariable analyses were revised as parsimonious logistic regression models, with model size and event counts reported.
RESULTS: The final cohort included 155 colon cancers: 29 mucinous and 126 classic adenocarcinomas. Mucinous tumours were more often right-sided (75.9% vs. 44.4%; p = 0.002) and more frequently poorly differentiated (24.1% vs. 4.8%; p = 0.003). Advanced pT stage was common in both groups (86.2% vs. 82.5%; p = 0.786). Nodal metastasis was numerically less frequent in mucinous adenocarcinoma (31.0% vs. 50.8%; p = 0.055), while lymphovascular invasion was significantly less common (10.3% vs. 32.5%; p = 0.017). Deficient mismatch repair was recorded in 13.8% of mucinous tumours and 8.7% of classic adenocarcinomas (p = 0.484). In parsimonious adjusted models, mucinous histology was not independently associated with advanced pT stage (adjusted OR 1.51, 95% CI 0.46-4.92; p = 0.496) or nodal metastasis (adjusted OR 0.48, 95% CI 0.19-1.19; p = 0.113).
CONCLUSIONS: In this colon-only cohort, mucinous adenocarcinoma was associated with right-sided location and poor differentiation, but not with independently higher local invasion or nodal spread. These findings support a cautious, clinicopathology-based interpretation of mucinous histology and should not be extrapolated to prognosis without molecular and survival data.

papers.title_zh: 大腸癌中黏液腺癌之臨床病理特徵：與傳統腺癌之比較
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：大腸黏液腺癌的定義為腫瘤內細胞外黏液成分佔比至少50%。雖常被視為獨立的組織學亞型，但其臨床病理特徵在已發表的系列研究中仍有變異。我們在一個僅限大腸（非直腸）的手術世代中，比較黏液腺癌與傳統腺癌。

方法：我們回溯性回顧2021年10月至2026年3月間接受大腸腺癌根治性切除之病人。排除直腸腫瘤、曾接受新輔助治療者及印戒細胞癌。臨床病理變項以Mann-Whitney U檢定、Pearson卡方檢定或Fisher精確檢定比較。多變項分析採用精簡化邏輯回歸模型，並報告模型大小與事件數。

結果：最終世代納入155例大腸癌：29例黏液腺癌、126例傳統腺癌。黏液腺癌較常位於右側大腸（75.9% vs. 44.4%；p = 0.002），且更常為低分化（24.1% vs. 4.8%；p = 0.003）。兩組進展期pT分期比例相近（86.2% vs. 82.5%；p = 0.786）。黏液腺癌之淋巴結轉移在數值上較少見（31.0% vs. 50.8%；p = 0.055），而淋巴血管侵犯顯著較少見（10.3% vs. 32.5%；p = 0.017）。錯配修復缺陷（dMMR）在黏液腺癌中佔13.8%，傳統腺癌中佔8.7%（p = 0.484）。在精簡化校正模型中，黏液組織型態與進展期pT分期（校正後OR 1.51，95% CI 0.46-4.92；p = 0.496）或淋巴結轉移（校正後OR 0.48，95% CI 0.19-1.19；p = 0.113）並無獨立相關性。

結論：在這個僅限大腸之世代中，黏液腺癌與右側位置及低分化有關，但並未獨立association於更高的局部侵犯或淋巴結擴散。這些發現支持對黏液組織型態採取謹慎、以臨床病理為基礎的解讀，不應在缺乏分子與存活資料的情況下外推至預後判斷。

papers.title: Primary K-pouch creation versus J-to-K pouch conversion: An IDEAL stage 3 report
papers.journal_full: Colorectal disease : the official journal of the Association of Coloproctology of Great Britain and Ireland
papers.authors: Abbasi A, Ge Y, Jia M, Testerman E, Marra V, Autencio K
papers.abstract:
AIM: Conversion of a failed ileoanal J-pouch to a continent ileostomy (K-pouch) is an uncommon salvage option that may preserve continence and small-bowel length. Outcomes after J-to-K pouch conversion compared with primary K-pouch creation remain poorly defined. This IDEAL stage 3 study compared short- and long-term outcomes between these two approaches.
METHOD: We performed a retrospective review of patients undergoing primary K-pouch creation or J-to-K pouch conversion at a tertiary referral centre between 2013 and 2025. Demographic, clinical and operative characteristics, 30-day postoperative outcomes and long-term pouch-related outcomes were evaluated. Primary outcomes were pouch revision and pouch excision. Secondary outcomes included 30-day morbidity and other long-term complications.
RESULTS: Forty-four patients were included, of whom 28 underwent primary K-pouch creation and 16 underwent J-to-K pouch conversion. Median age, body mass index, operation duration and blood loss were comparable between groups. Thirty-day outcomes, including readmission, reoperation, ileus, abscess and transfusion, did not differ significantly. After a median follow-up of 43 vs. 42 months, pouch survival remained high in both groups (82.1% vs. 93.8%, p = 0.39). Kaplan-Meier analysis demonstrated similar revision-free (p = 0.39) and excision-free (p = 0.36) survival. On multivariable analysis, 30-day transfusion was the only independent predictor of pouch failure (odds ratio [OR] 7.56, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.02-56.25; p = 0.048).
CONCLUSION: J-to-K pouch conversion achieved high pouch survival and 30-day morbidity comparable to primary K-pouch creation, supporting its role as an effective salvage option in selected patients with J-pouch failure.
papers.title_zh: 原發性K型儲袋建立 versus J型轉K型儲袋轉換術：一項IDEAL第三階段報告
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：將失敗的迴腸肛門J型儲袋轉換為可自制迴腸造口（K型儲袋）是一種少見的補救選項，可能保留肛門自制功能與小腸長度。J型轉K型儲袋轉換術與原發性K型儲袋建立之結果比較，目前仍定義不明。本IDEAL第三階段研究比較此兩種術式之短期與長期結果。方法：我們回溯性審查2013至2025年間於一所三級轉診中心接受原發性K型儲袋建立或J型轉K型儲袋轉換術之病人。評估人口學、臨床與手術特徵、術後30天結果，以及長期儲袋相關結果。主要結果為儲袋修復（revision）與儲袋切除（excision）。次要結果包括30天併發症及其他長期併發症。結果：共納入44位病人，其中28位接受原發性K型儲袋建立，16位接受J型轉K型儲袋轉換術。兩組之年齡中位數、身體質量指數、手術時間及失血量皆相當。30天結果（包括再入院、再手術、腸阻塞、腹內膿瘍及輸血）無顯著差異。追蹤中位數43個月 vs 42個月後，兩組儲袋存活率均維持高水準（82.1% vs 93.8%，p = 0.39）。Kaplan-Meier分析顯示兩組之無修復存活率（p = 0.39）與無切除存活率（p = 0.36）相似。多變項分析顯示，30天內輸血是儲袋失敗唯一的獨立預測因子（勝算比[OR] 7.56，95%信賴區間1.02–56.25；p = 0.048）。結論：J型轉K型儲袋轉換術達到與原發性K型儲袋建立相當之高儲袋存活率及30天併發症率，支持其作為部分精選J型儲袋失敗病人之有效補救選項。

papers.title: Mitochondrial dysfunction as a metabolic checkpoint of immunotherapy response in colorectal cancer
papers.authors: Tomassini L, Colella M, Monteleone G, Stolfi C, Laudisi F
papers.abstract: Immunotherapy has markedly improved outcomes across multiple cancer types; however, colorectal cancer (CRC) remains largely refractory, with meaningful responses mostly restricted to tumors harboring deficient mismatch repair and high microsatellite instability (dMMR/MSI-H), which represent only a small fraction of CRC cases. Emerging evidence suggests that mitochondrial dysfunction may be viewed as a metabolic checkpoint, representing a conceptual framework through which mitochondrial-dependent processes regulate antitumor immunity and immunotherapy response in CRC. In tumor cells, mitochondrial reprogramming enhances reliance on oxidative phosphorylation, promotes hypoxia, and drives metabolite accumulation, collectively shaping an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment. In parallel, tumor-infiltrating T-cells exhibit mitochondrial dysfunction characterized by impaired biogenesis, reduced respiratory capacity and features of exhaustion, thereby limiting the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). In this review, we summarize current insights into the role of mitochondrial pathways in regulating tumor immune escape and T-cell dysfunction in CRC. We further discuss emerging therapeutic strategies aimed at targeting metabolic vulnerabilities to overcome resistance and potentially enhance responses to immunotherapy.

papers.abstract_zh: 免疫治療已顯著改善多種癌症之預後；然而，大腸直腸癌（CRC）仍大多對免疫治療反應不佳，有意義的治療反應主要侵限於帶有錯配修復缺陷及高度微衛星不穩定性（dMMR/MSI-H）之腫瘤，而此類腫瘤僅佔CRC病例中的一小部分。新興證據顯示，線粒體功能障礙可被視為一種代謝檢查點，代表一個概念性框架，透過此框架線粒體依賴性過程調控CRC中的抗腫瘤免疫反應及免疫治療反應。在腫瘤細胞中，線粒體重編程增強其對氧化磷酸化的依賴性，促進缺氧狀態，並驅動代謝物累積，共同塑造出免疫抑制性腫瘤微環境。同時，腫瘤浸潤性T細胞表現出線粒體功能障礙，特徵包括生物合成受損、呼吸能力降低及耗竭特徵，因而限制免疫檢查點抑制劑（ICIs）之療效。在本篇綜述中，我們總結目前對線粒體路徑在調控CRC腫瘤免疫逃逸及T細胞功能障礙中角色之見解。我們進一步討論針對代謝脆弱性之新興治療策略，以克服抗藥性並可能增強對免疫治療之反應。

papers.title: The shifting balance: innate lymphoid cell plasticity in chronic gut diseases
papers.authors: Ling P, Fang J, Wang J, Xu Y, Huang N, Mu R
papers.abstract: Innate lymphoid cells (ILCs), as core components of innate immunity, coordinate mucosal immune defense and homeostasis through their functional plasticity. They exhibit functional diversity in the intestine and display a complex dual role in intestinal diseases, which is closely associated with their phenotypic transformation and functional reprogramming. Current studies have demonstrated that ILCs play critical roles in various chronic intestinal diseases, including autoimmune intestinal disorders, chronic infectious intestinal inflammation, and colorectal cancer. However, the specific functions and reprogramming mechanisms of ILC subsets remain controversial across different types of intestinal diseases. This review provides a comprehensive overview of current research on the mechanisms of ILCs in chronic intestinal diseases, aiming to advance the development of immunotherapeutic strategies targeting ILC reprogramming and offer novel insights into the prevention and treatment of intestinal diseases.

papers.title: H19 and the PD-1/PD-L1 Axis in hepatocellular carcinoma and colorectal cancer: emerging evidence, mechanistic links, and therapeutic perspectives
papers.authors: Nami M, EmamiPari F, Farrokhi N, Fattahyan I, Yekkalam M
papers.abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and colorectal cancer (CRC) are major causes of cancer-related mortality, yet responses to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) remain heterogeneous. Although programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) is a key component of immune checkpoint biology, antitumor immunity is shaped by multiple tumor-intrinsic and microenvironmental factors, and the contribution of the long non-coding RNA H19 to these processes remains incompletely defined. This narrative review synthesizes experimental and clinical evidence linking H19 to immune regulation in HCC and CRC, with particular emphasis on its potential intersection with PD-L1-mediated immune checkpoint signaling. Evidence was classified as experimentally demonstrated, indirectly supported, contextual, or hypothetical according to the strength, mechanistic resolution, and disease specificity of the available data. Current evidence indicates that H19 perturbation can influence PD-L1-associated phenotypes in selected experimental HCC models; however, a complete, mechanistically resolved H19-dependent PD-L1 regulatory axis, including validated intermediate mechanisms and causal rescue, has not been established in HCC or CRC. Proposed ceRNA and signaling mechanisms remain incompletely validated, while several mechanistic links are supported primarily by indirect or cross-cancer evidence. Beyond direct checkpoint regulation, H19-associated extracellular vesicles and H19-dependent signaling have been implicated in macrophage remodeling, intercellular communication, and T-cell dysfunction, although direct convergence of these processes on H19-mediated PD-L1 regulation remains unproven. Circulating H19 has also shown preliminary associations with tumor presence or burden, but its clinical utility as a diagnostic, prognostic, or predictive biomarker remains insufficiently validated, particularly for ICI response. Overall, H19 represents a biologically plausible interface between non-coding RNA regulation, tumor-intrinsic signaling, and the tumor immune microenvironment rather than an established central regulator of PD-L1. Disease-specific mechanistic studies incorporating H19 perturbation, PD-L1 measurement, pathway-specific rescue, and immune-functional assays are required to determine whether H19 can serve as a clinically actionable component of immune checkpoint regulation.

papers.abstract_zh: 肝細胞癌（HCC）與大腸直腸癌（CRC）是癌症相關死亡的主要原因，然而對免疫檢查點抑制劑（ICIs）的反應仍具高度異質性。儘管程式化死亡配體1（PD-L1）是免疫檢查點生物學的關鍵成分，但抗腫瘤免疫受多種腫瘤內在與微環境因子所影響，而長鏈非編碼RNA H19對這些過程的貢獻仍未完全闡明。本敘述性綜述整合實驗與臨床證據，說明H19與HCC及CRC中免疫調控的關聯，特別聚焦於其與PD-L1媒介之免疫檢查點訊號可能的交互作用。證據依其強度、機轉解析度與疾病特異性，分類為實驗證實、間接支持、情境相關或假設性。目前證據顯示，在特定實驗性HCC模型中，H19的干擾可影響PD-L1相關表現型；然而，在HCC或CRC中，一個完整、機轉上已解析的H19依賴性PD-L1調控軸（包含經驗證的中介機轉與因果挽救實驗）尚未建立。所提出的ceRNA與訊號傳導機轉仍未完全驗證，部分機轉連結主要由間接證據或跨癌症類型證據所支持。除了直接的檢查點調控之外，H19相關之外泌體與H19依賴性訊號傳導已被牽涉於巨噬細胞重塑、細胞間通訊與T細胞功能失調，惟這些過程是否直接匯聚於H19媒介的PD-L1調控仍未獲證實。循環中的H19濃度也已初步顯示與腫瘤存在或腫瘤負荷相關，但其作為診斷、預後或預測性生物標記（特別是對ICI反應）的臨床效用仍尚未充分驗證。整體而言，H19代表非編碼RNA調控、腫瘤內在訊號傳導與腫瘤免疫微環境之間一個具生物學合理性的交會點，而非PD-L1的既定核心調控者。需要納入H19干擾、PD-L1測量、路徑特異性挽救實驗與免疫功能性檢測的疾病特異性機轉研究，才能確定H19是否能成為免疫檢查點調控中具臨床可行動性的一環。

papers.title: Tripartite Interplay of Epithelial, Immune, and Microbiota Dysregulation in Crohn's Disease: Mechanisms and Translational Strategies
papers.authors: Lai Q, Zhang Q, Yang W, Luo C
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Crohn's disease (CD) is a multifactorial inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) characterized by impaired epithelial barrier integrity, excessive immune hyperactivation, and gut microbiota perturbations. Cumulative evidence supports the role of the intestinal epithelial barrier, immune system and gut microbiota in the progression of CD.
OBJECTIVE: This review constructs a mechanistic framework of the epithelial-immune-microbiota tripartite network in CD with a focus on positive‑feedback circuits sustaining persistent intestinal inflammation.
KEY FINDINGS: Interrelated pathological loops involving barrier injury, immune activation and microbial dysbiosis perpetuate chronic intestinal inflammation and provide a rationale for mechanism‑guided combinatorial therapeutic interventions.
CONCLUSIONS: This framework illuminates key pathogenic crosstalk that may be targeted to optimize future treatment regimens for CD.

papers.title: Conclusions and Therapeutic Implications of AA
papers.journal_full: Reviews of physiology, biochemistry and pharmacology
papers.abstract: AA is essential for several tissues in the body, as they are involved in many physiological and pathological processes. Its regulatory role in inflammation, immune response regulation, cell cycle, and membrane structural organization and its ability to control the expression and function(s) of several receptors and convey messages to and from the nucleus are of particular significance. Fine-tuning the metabolism of AA may lead to the development of prevention and management strategies for several diseases, including but not limited to sepsis, inflammatory bowel disease, diabetes mellitus, cancer, coronary heart disease, atherosclerosis, MASLD (NAFLD), hypertension, metabolic syndrome, uveitis, glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, glomerulonephritis, ischemia-reperfusion injury, lupus, rheumatoid arthritis, and drug-resistant infections and cancer. AA is needed for normal brain growth and development, pregnancy, regeneration of the liver and heart, and hematopoiesis. AA can be administered orally, parenterally as needed, and as lipid nanoparticles to target specific tissues.
